about.title: Coldroom & Refrigeration Specialists
about.content: Frigtec specialises in commercial coldrooms and refrigeration systems across Brisbane and the Gold Coast. From walk-in coolrooms and freezers to complete refrigeration installations, we provide expert service, emergency repairs and professional maintenance to keep your cold storage running efficiently and minimise costly downtime.
